title: C: Observer Pattern
description: Implement the Observer design pattern with a subject that notifies multiple observers via callback function pointers.

steps.title: Observer Registration and Notification
steps.description: Define an `Observer` struct with a function pointer `void (*notify)(int event)` and an id. Create a `Subject` struct that holds up to 10 observers and broadcasts events to all registered observers. Test with 2 observers.
hints: Subject stores an array of Observer pointers and a count.
Notify: call each observer's notify function.

verification.failureMessage: Both observers should be notified with event 42
